products.name: The Viceroy Full-Grain Bridle Belt
products.shortDescription: 38mm English bridle cut with hand-burnished edges and solid antiqued brass buckle.
products.description: Hand-cut from 9–10 oz vegetable-tanned full-grain cowhide, The Viceroy is built to endure decades of wear. Every edge is beveled, sealed with organic beeswax, and burnished by hand on wooden wheels. Paired with a solid cast brass roller buckle secured by dual Chicago screws for effortless buckle swapping.
products.leatherType: Full-Grain Vegetable-Tanned English Bridle Cowhide (4.0mm thickness)
products.hardware: Solid Cast Antique Brass with Heavy Roller
features: Solid forged brass roller buckle
Hand-beveled and beeswax-burnished edges
Dual Chicago screw construction for hardware replacement
Saddle-stitched keeper loop with 0.6mm waxed linen thread
Ages naturally into a rich, lustrous patina
products.careInstructions: Condition annually with natural beeswax and neatsfoot leather balm. Keep away from prolonged direct water immersion.

products.name: The Grandmaster Dress Belt
products.shortDescription: 32mm tapered formal belt in smooth French calfskin with brushed brass hardware.
products.description: A discreetly elegant dress belt tailored for tailored trousers and suits. Crafted from supple French calfskin layered over a resilient vegetable-tanned core, finished with perimeter saddle-stitching and a brushed champagne brass buckle.
products.leatherType: Aniline French Box Calfskin with Veg-Tan reinforcement
features: Beveled edge profile with feathered crease lines
Ultra-fine perimeter saddle stitching
Lined in soft vegetable-tanned natural calfskin
Hypoallergenic brass hardware
products.careInstructions: Buff gently with a soft horsehair brush and apply neutral cream polish.

products.name: The Oudh Heritage Bifold Wallet
products.shortDescription: Classic 8-card bifold hand saddle-stitched with waxed French linen thread.
products.description: The Oudh represents traditional leathercraft in its purest form. Hand-cut from Tuscan vegetable-tanned shoulder leather, each seam is punched with French-style pricking irons and saddle-stitched by hand with two needles. Holds 8 credit cards, double receipt slots, and a full-length cash compartment suited for Indian Rupee banknotes.
products.hardware: Zero synthetic linings, 100% natural leather interior
features: 8 dedicated card pockets with turned thumb access
Dual hidden interior receipt flaps
Full-depth billfold for flat storage of all INR currency notes
Hand saddle-stitched (will never unravel even if a stitch is cut)
Complimentary custom hot-foil monogramming
products.careInstructions: The natural oils in your hands keep the leather conditioned. Re-hydrate with natural leather cream once every 6 months.

products.name: The Chhatrapati Minimalist Card Wallet
products.shortDescription: Slim front-pocket cardholder with central folded cash pocket.
products.description: Designed for the discerning minimalist who carries essentials only. Accommodates 6 cards with a central lined pouch for folded bills, transit passes, or business cards. Slim enough to slide undetected into suit breast pockets or front jeans pockets.
features: 4 precision-beveled exterior card slots
1 central cash/receipt pocket
Ultra-thin 6mm empty profile
Hand-creased edge borders
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a clean dry microfiber cloth. Avoid overstuffing during the break-in week.

products.name: The Rani Cinch Waist Belt
products.shortDescription: Sculptural 28mm waist belt with hand-cast brass loop and tapered spear tip.
products.description: An architectural statement piece tailored to cinch coats, wrap dresses, and tailored blazers. Handcrafted from supple vegetable-tanned grain leather with a delicate feathered edge, highlighted by our signature hand-cast interlocking brass ring inspired by royal heritage motifs.
features: Versatile cinch closure fits both high waist and mid-rise wear
Hand-painted satin edge finishing
Subtle debossed Bharatvarsh workshop emblem on inner lining
Polished brass hardware with anti-tarnish protective coating
products.careInstructions: Store hanging or loosely coiled. Buff with a soft cotton cloth.

products.name: The Malabar Skinny Trouser Belt
products.shortDescription: 18mm delicate trouser belt with rounded horseshoe brass buckle.
products.description: Graceful, understated, and timeless. Cut to a narrow 18mm silhouette with hand-skived edges that thread effortlessly through delicate trouser and denim belt loops.
features: Slim 18mm profile
Seven micro-spaced adjustment holes for precise fit
Tonal edge burnish with natural plant oils
products.careInstructions: Keep dry and store in the provided organic cotton dust bag.

products.name: The Nilgiri Continental Zip Wallet
products.shortDescription: Generous accordion clutch wallet with 12 card slots and zippered coin partition.
products.description: Crafted for effortless organization. Unzips to reveal an expansive accordion interior lined in supple goatskin and veg-tan leather. Featuring 12 card slots, dual full-length currency sleeves, smartphone capacity, and a smooth Swiss-engineered brass zipper.
products.hardware: Solid Brass Heavy-Duty Teeth Zipper (YKK Excella)
features: 12 card slots with anti-stretch leather reinforcement
Interior zippered coin pocket with custom leather pull
Fits iPhone Pro Max or flagship smartphones easily
RFID-shielded internal lining
products.careInstructions: Condition every six months. Clean zipper teeth with a soft toothbrush if required.

products.name: The Avani Compact Flap Wallet
products.shortDescription: Tri-fold compact wallet with snap coin pouch and six card sleeves.
products.description: The ideal companion for compact crossbody bags. Features a tactile brass snap closure, an origami-folded external coin pocket, and a dedicated cash bill compartment without excess bulk.
features: Exterior gusseted coin pocket with snap cover
6 interior vertical card slots
Full-size currency sleeve
Finished with contrasting cream saddle stitch
products.careInstructions: Protect from heavy rain; pat dry immediately with an absorbent towel.

products.name: The Chandragiri Saddle Crossbody Purse
products.shortDescription: Curved equestrian silhouette with turn-lock brass clasp and adjustable shoulder strap.
products.description: Inspired by timeless equestrian saddlebags, The Chandragiri is structured yet soft to the touch. Featuring an articulated curved base, hand-burnished raw edges, solid brass hardware with our signature stitched ring charm, and an adjustable cross-body strap.
products.hardware: Solid Antiqued Cast Brass Turn-Lock & Ring Charm
features: Curved equestrian body with reinforced gusset
Solid brass turn-lock clasp with tactile click
Interior zip compartment and smartphone slip
Includes authentic circular Bharatvarsh stitched leather charm
Adjustable 110cm - 130cm shoulder strap
products.careInstructions: Store in the unbleached cotton dust bag with tissue paper stuffing to preserve its structured contour.

products.name: The Ganga Artisanal Day Clutch
products.shortDescription: Minimalist envelope clutch with detachable wristlet and magnetic horn-stud closure.
products.description: A seamless transition from day meetings to evening soirees. Clean geometric envelope flap secured by hidden rare-earth magnetic closures, fitted with an interior zip pocket and card organizer.
products.hardware: Concealed Magnetic Closures & Brass Swivel Clip
features: Detachable 20cm leather wristlet strap with solid brass swivel hook
Raw suede interior lining
4 built-in quick access card slots
Hand saddle-stitched borders
products.careInstructions: Wipe down with a dry flannel cloth after wear. Keep away from solvent perfumes.

products.name: The Himalaya Heritage Rucksack
products.shortDescription: Rugged luxury roll-top backpack with padded 16" laptop sleeve and solid brass hardware.
products.description: Engineered for expeditions and daily metropolitan commutes alike. Built from heavyweight 2.2mm full-grain pull-up leather that lightens where folded to record every adventure in an incredible patina. Features padded ergonomic shoulder straps lined in breathable natural wool felt, quick-access front pockets, and a suspended laptop suite.
products.hardware: Cast Solid Brass Roller Buckles, Rivets & Dog-Clips
products.dimensions: 42.0 cm x 30.0 cm x 14.0 cm (Expandable to 50cm roll-top)
features: Suspended padded sleeve fits up to 16" MacBook Pro / laptop
Expandable roll-top closure with twin solid brass cinch straps
Exterior side pocket for water bottle or umbrella
Comfort-padded shoulder straps with wool felt underlay
Solid copper hand-peened rivets at critical stress points
products.careInstructions: Scratches can be rubbed out with your thumb due to the rich oil content in pull-up leather. Apply heavy wax balm once a year.

products.name: The Deccan Commuter Leather Backpack
products.shortDescription: Streamlined city backpack with clamshell opening and luggage trolley strap.
products.description: A sophisticated urban commuter pack with a structured silhouette that stands upright when placed on the ground. Features an integrated rear luggage sleeve to slip over suitcase handles and a hidden passport security pocket against the back panel.
features: Rear travel trolley sleeve for seamless airport navigation
180-degree clamshell opening for easy packing
Reinforced top grab handle hand-stitched with 40 saddle stitches
Dual pen holders and business card organizational slots
products.careInstructions: Keep away from damp floors. Condition periodically to preserve leather suppleness.

products.name: The Sovereign English Bridle Briefcase
products.shortDescription: Heirloom legal briefcase with solid brass English lock and hand-stitched rolled handle.
products.description: The crowning achievement of Bharatvarsh Leathercrafts LLP. Master-crafted over 36 bench hours from heavy English bridle leather. Designed with a hand-formed rolled leather handle built around a rawhide core, triple gusset compartments for legal briefs and laptops, and a working solid brass locking clasp with bespoke key tassel.
products.leatherType: Grade-A English Bridle Leather (3.2mm hide thickness)
products.hardware: British-Style Solid Cast Brass Mortise Key Lock with Working Key
features: Triple gusseted interior partitions with document sleeves
Hand-molded rolled leather handle (tested to 40kg load capacity)
Detachable all-leather shoulder strap with padded weight-dispersal pad
Working solid brass key lock with embossed leather key-bell
Brass base studs protect bottom leather from floor friction
products.careInstructions: Treat like an heirloom. Wax and polish with pure carnauba cream twice a year. Guaranteed for life.

products.name: The Viceroy Slim Attaché Case
products.shortDescription: Sleek single-gusset laptop briefcase in vegetable-tanned saddle leather.
products.description: A modern, slimline briefcase for executives and professionals. Holds a 15" laptop, tablet, charger cables, and notebook in a clean 6.5cm low-profile form factor that retains its sharp structure indefinitely.
products.leatherType: Vegetable-Tanned Full-Grain Cowhide with Satin Sheen
products.hardware: Solid Brass Two-Way Top Zipper & Antique Brass D-Rings
features: Padded central compartment fits up to 15" laptop
Full-width magnetic rear magazine pocket
Removable webbing-backed leather shoulder strap
Edge creased and hand-burnished with natural carnauba wax
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a clean dry microfiber cloth and avoid prolonged exposure to rain.
